svg.title: Aperture Chat — a 35-second tour of the current interface
svg.desc: An animated sequence of current interface captures: chat, documents, slide decks, agents, knowledge, and mobile. The local workspace has no model provider connected. Document and slide content is manually authored and synthetic; no generated responses or configured integrations are implied. Screens are captured states, not a real-time recording.

g.text: Start with a clean, governed workspace.
Choose the appearance that suits your work.
Write and format a working document.
Turn a document into editable slides.
A compact composer for smaller screens.
